mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.faq_id, v.question, v.answer, v.question_embedding, v.answer_embedding, v.combined_embedding, v.sparse_embedding FROM faq_vector_store v INNER JOIN faq_items f ON v.faq_id = f.faq_id WHERE f.display_status = 1

SELECT v.id, v.doc_id, v.chunk_index, v.chunk_content, v.chunk_embedding, v.chunk_metadata, v.sparse_embedding, d.doc_name FROM knowledge_vector_store v LEFT JOIN knowledge_docs d ON v.doc_id = d.doc_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO faq_vector_store (faq_id, question, answer, question_embedding, answer_embedding, combined_embedding, sparse_embedding) VALUES (#{faqId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{questionEmbedding}, #{answerEmbedding}, #{combinedEmbedding}, #{sparseEmbedding})

INSERT INTO knowledge_vector_store (doc_id, chunk_index, chunk_content, chunk_embedding, chunk_metadata, sparse_embedding) VALUES (#{docId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{chunkContent}, #{chunkEmbedding}, #{chunkMetadata}, #{sparseEmbedding})
